rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for marble rock in Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: The kitchen countertop is made of marble, so it’s quite easy to clean.
example.traditional: 廚房個枱面用雲石整，清潔起上嚟幾方便。
example.jyutping: cyu4 fong2 go3 toi4 min6 jung6 wan4 sek6 zing2 cing1 git3 hei2 soeng6 lei4 gei2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this more formal or technical term for marble rock, especially in writing or descriptions of building materials.

example.english: The architect specified in the report that marble would be used for the exterior walls.
example.traditional: 建築師喺報告入面寫明，外牆會採用大理石。
example.jyutping: gin3 zuk1 si1 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 se2 ming4 ngoi6 coeng4 wui5 coi2 jung6 daai6 lei5 sek6

rows.note: Use this for the small toy ball used in children's games, not for the rock.

example.english: When I was little, I often carried a marble around in my pocket.
example.traditional: 細個嗰陣，我成日袋住粒波子周圍走。
example.jyutping: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 doi6 zyu6 nap1 bo1 zi2 zau1 wai4 zau2
